objective: Create auditable evidence that verified hospitality businesses will pay recurring money for HOY because it creates useful, measurable operating or demand-generation value.

sponsoredHighlightSeparate.note: Existing promotion-insights runtime describes EUR 29 per event as a recommended launch price subject to manual HOY approval. It is not evidence of accepted market pricing.

pricingExperiment.comparisonRule: Never show the three arms together as fake choice architecture during the validation experiment.
pricingExperiment.changeRule: Do not change an assigned price after the merchant sees it unless the merchant explicitly requests a revised commercial scope; record any change as a protocol deviation.
pricingExperiment.winnerRule: No winning price before sufficient real offers, settled payments and renewal evidence. Optimize for paid conversion plus retention and merchant outcome, not first-payment conversion alone.

proofAccounting.refundTreatment: A fully refunded first payment does not count as retained paid proof; preserve both payment and refund in evidence.
proofAccounting.grossRevenueDefinition: Settled external customer consideration before payment fees, taxes and refunds, separately reconciled.
proofAccounting.mrrDefinition: Recurring monthly contracted value supported by currently active external paying businesses; one-off sponsored events excluded from MRR.

claimBoundary: This file defines a commercial validation protocol. It is not a live tariff, not a promise that merchants will pay, and not evidence of recurring revenue until external settled payments and renewal data exist.
